prompt: Create a parent-child comparison sheet of Luke the white squirrel mascot. Image 1 is the strict adult Luke shape/style reference. Image 2 is reference ONLY for child cheek treatment and subtle eye highlights; do NOT draw birds. Two squirrels standing front-facing side by side on same ground baseline, adult LEFT, child RIGHT uniformly scaled to about 75% adult linear size. Adult faithful to original Luke: domed head with softly bulging lower cheeks, upright pointed tufted squirrel ears, small crown fur tuft, circular brown glasses, dark brown eyes/nose, friendly curved squirrel mouth, large curving bushy tail behind at viewer right with single inward spiral, white pocket vest, yellow loosely tied scarf, orange U with two dots on viewer right upper chest, white limbs/paws. No magnifying glass or other props. Child preserves SAME head outline/aspect ratio and head-to-body proportions scaled smaller, same round glasses in proportion, same tail curl direction. Only child differences: ear-tip fur tufts shorter and gently rounder (ears remain upright squirrel ears, not rabbit ears); tail tip fur points a little softer, same iconic curled tail; tiny pale pink cheek patches with three short rosy-brown diagonal hatch strokes EACH; one small white highlight in each otherwise unchanged dark eye; tiny playful crown tuft, restrained. Parent no blush/highlights. Both matching clean smooth warm brown outlines, NOT wobbly/furry line treatment, approx #A77C65 outlines, dark brown eyes/nose/glasses #6B5143, scarf muted yellow #D7C862 and orange chest logo #FF511B. White body, very subtle paper texture like reference, no heavy shading. Simple plain solid white background, no halos no gradients no shadows no labels no text. Both whole figures and tails fully visible, generous space between. Preserve recognizable Luke character identity rather than generic baby squirrel.

torso_revision.prompt: Subtle controlled proportion edit to Luke squirrel parent-child sheet. Adult LEFT completely unchanged. Child RIGHT ONLY shorten torso vertically from scarf bottom to crotch by approx SEVEN percent (0.93 current torso height), same width, legs and feet same baseline and size. Move head with ears/glasses/features as a rigid unscaled unit slightly downward to meet torso. Do NOT change head outline, aspect ratio, eyes, highlights, nose/mouth spacing, cheek hatches or ear tufts. Preserve tail shape, size and spiral; only minimally reconnect at hip if needed. Keep white vest yellow scarf orange logo, gently shortening vest hem and pockets as necessary without changing design. No bigger head or baby redesign; no eye changes. Same clean smooth brown line style and colors, same canvas and plain white background. No shadows no labels no text. Goal slight compactness of child trunk only, all other features match existing.
